This case-sensitive code system https://fhir.speirotech.net/CodeSystem/speiro-flag-scope defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition

unit-window Unit windowThe flag concerns one or more identified verification windows.
provider ProviderThe flag concerns provider facts.
client ClientThe flag concerns client facts.
client-presence Client presenceThe flag concerns observed client presence.
authorization AuthorizationThe flag concerns authorization context.
